thread.element: ethylene gas cloud spreading from the fruit bowl

copy.headline: Your apples are silently killing your lettuce.
Some fruits emit ethylene gas as they ripen.
items: Ethylene accelerates aging in everything around it.
If you store the wrong items together, you're cutting their shelf life in half.

copy.headline: High ethylene producers (keep isolated):
copy.body: Apples · Bananas · Avocados · Tomatoes · Peaches · Pears · Mangoes · Melons

copy.headline: One apple in the crisper drawer with your spinach can cut the spinach from 7 days to 3.
copy.body: Same food. Same fridge. Different neighbors.

copy.headline: The rule is simple:
items: fruit drawer and vegetable drawer should never mix.
If your fridge only has one drawer, keep the ethylene producers in a separate bag.

copy.headline: We built an app that tracks all of this automatically.
